profile.description: KLA Corporation is an American company based in Milpitas, California that makes wafer fab equipment. It supplies process control and yield management systems for the semiconductor industry and other related nanoelectronics industries.
profile.description_zh: KLA Corporation（科磊公司）是一家美国公司，总部位于加利福尼亚州米尔皮塔斯，制造晶圆厂设备。它为半导体行业及其他相关纳米电子行业提供过程控制和良率管理系统。
